_about: /ask API contract for the Group 7 chatbot (Ethan <-> Ahmed). /ask/stream, /health and the busy (503) reply added 3 Nov. Example data only: URLs, places and the wellbeing wording are placeholders.

body.question: How do I reset my university password?

request.rules: question must be a non-empty string, max 500 characters

body.answer: Plain-English answer written only from the saved SHU pages.
Sorry, I couldn't find that in the SHU pages I have. Hallam Help can answer most questions: https://www.shu.ac.uk/myhallam/help-and-support
Here are some places near City Campus.
[Fixed wellbeing message - wording to be copied from the SHU wellbeing page, Ahmed to confirm]

safety_triggered._example_question: a message mentioning an eating disorder (illustrative)

body.error: The assistant is busy with other questions. Please try again in a minute.

busy._note: Only if a question waited over 2 minutes for the model (it answers one question at a time).

rate_limited.body: Returned by Nginx, not Flask - may be HTML, so the page should show a generic 'too many requests, try again shortly' message.

body.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

field_notes.answer: string - always present on 200. Insert with textContent, not innerHTML.
field_notes.sources: list of {title, url} - pages the answer was drawn from. Empty when unanswered or a places question. When safety is true: the fixed SHU links chosen by safety.py (urgent help plus the matching topic page), never generated by the model. Page titles to be checked against the live pages.
field_notes.places: list of {name, type, distance_m, map_url} - empty unless the question is about local food/coffee/shops
field_notes.safety: bool - true means the model was skipped; answer is the fixed wellbeing message and sources are fixed links to SHU's urgent help and topic pages. These pages are deliberately not in the chatbot's index.
field_notes.time_ms: int - server-side time, logged for the test spreadsheet

safety_and_places_functions.safety.py: check(question: str) -> dict | None  (returns {'message': str, 'sources': [{'title', 'url'}]} if triggered, else None; each keyword group maps to its SHU topic page, always plus urgent help)
safety_and_places_functions.places.py: lookup(question: str) -> list[dict] | None  (returns places for local questions, else None)
safety_and_places_functions.note: app.py calls safety.check() first and returns straight away if it triggers, then places.lookup(). Put safety.py and places.py in the chatbot/ folder next to app.py; until they are there, app.py runs without them.

streaming._about: Optional second way to ask: the answer types out live, like ChatGPT. Same request body as /ask; the reply is NDJSON (one JSON object per line).

body.question: How do I get my SHUcard?

example_lines.text: Collect your SHUcard from the Library help desk

example_lines.answer: Collect your SHUcard from the Library help desk with photo ID.

event_types.status: a step to show greyed out ('Searching...', 'Reading: <page titles>', 'Writing...'). stage is one of waiting, searching, reading, writing. 'reading' also lists the pages being read.
event_types.text: add this text to the end of the answer on screen (textContent += text).
event_types.done: always the last line when it worked. Same fields as a /ask 200 response. Replace the typed-out text with done.answer (it is the tidied final version), then show sources/places.
event_types.error: instead of done if something went wrong: {"type": "error", "error": "..."} - show the message.

notes: Safety, places, greetings and 'not found' replies skip the model, so they come back as a single done line.
Bad requests still get a normal 400 JSON response, not a stream.
Reading the stream in the browser: fetch() then response.body.getReader(), split on newlines and JSON.parse each line. templates/test_chat.html has a working example (askStream).
Nginx on VM 1 needs proxy_buffering off (or the X-Accel-Buffering header, which Flask already sends) and proxy_read_timeout 180s for this path.
If the student leaves the page, the model stops writing that answer.

body.settings: Qwen/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, top 2 extracts, max 80 tokens, 4 CPU threads

health.note: For Waiyan's failover check. busy = the model is answering a question right now. safety/places = whether safety.py and places.py were found.
